content:
incident-bot: ALERT -> p99 latency spike detected in eu-west-1 dedicated pools for serving-runtime. p99 = 3.9s (SLO 2.5s). Queue depth rising. Paging oncall-sre. :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: I’m on it. noticed p95 creeping too (1.2s -> 1.9s). Starting quick triage — checking autoscaler and pool warmup metrics.

maya: seeing a surge from a handful of customers (rushscale job spikes). KV-cache cold hits up ~40% on short sessions.

oncall-sre: run: `kubectl get pods -l pool=dedicated-eu --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp` -> many pods healthy but new nodes not entering Ready fast.

oncall-sre: `curl http://metrics/api?query=autoscaler_warmup_seconds` -> 95th warmup ~ 65s for new slot (expected ~10s). suspect hypervisor warmup / image pull slow.

raj: tagging eng-runtime. @santiago can you confirm autoscaler healthy / control-plane handshake latencies?

santiago: looking. control-plane reports backlog on handshake RPCs ~ 1200ms, and slot registration retries increasing. Tracing shows slow artifact fetch from image registry in eu-west-1 region.

emily: support-ecs reporting ~2.3% of streaming sessions saw stalls >2s and a small set of customers saw errors (some 503s) during the spike. Customer impact: degraded latency, not full outage.

ops-lead: we should open a live bridge. Recommend immediate mitigations: 1) manual scale existing hot pool by +30% (avoid new cold slots), 2) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model for non-critical customers, 3) put rate limit on low-tier tenants for next 20m.

oncall-sre: executing manual scale now: `platformctl scale-pool --pool dedicated-eu-hotshot --replicas +30%` — verifying token.

oncall-sre: scaled hot pool, verified increased throughput on current hosts. p99 dropping to ~2.8s but still above SLO.

support-ecs: posting customer-facing note: "We're seeing elevated latency in EU. Teams are mitigating; small percentage of streaming sessions may stall. We'll provide updates."

santiago: workaround to reduce warmup: toggle image cache bypass to use pre-pulled runtime snapshot for this pool. rolling that change to hot pool now.

emily: tracking affected customers and opening incident ticket IN-2026-089. list pinned in support doc.

raj: handoff to eng-runtime for deeper root cause. oncall-sre -> raj at 6876543500. @santiago, please own the live bridge. severity set to Sev2.

santiago: acknowledged. will check registry latency, reach out to infra for registry IO. plan: revert to pre-pulled images, add temporary read-through cache, then re-enable autoscaler. ETA 15m for patch, 45m for full stabilization.

oncall-sre: confirm fallback routing applied: `routerctl set-fallback --model small-quant --target low-tier` -> applied. monitoring for error regression.

ops-lead: please collect logs for warmup handshake 6876543200-6876543600 window and mark any correlation with large customer spikes.

support-ecs: customers notified via status page and direct DM for top 5 accounts. No escalations to execs yet.

maya: metrics: queue depth dropped after scale but tail latencies still high on streaming servo nodes. suspect KV cold path + per-request kernel selection wobble.

santiago: captured heap of one failing slot, dumping logs to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/6876543210/trace.log. Sharing brief in bridge.

emily: SLO update: p95 back within target, p99 still 2.6-3.0s. Continue mitigation window.

oncall-sre: switching pager to next for extended response. handing off monitoring to raj (eng-runtime) at 6876543700. I'll stay on bridge for 10m overlap.

ops-lead: agreed next steps: (A) infra to investigate registry IO (B) eng-runtime to add pre-pull cron for hot pools (C) platform to add guardrail to prevent autoscaler from creating too many cold slots during rushscale bursts. Postmortem required, assign owners.

support-ecs: incident ticket updated with timeline and customer notes. Will update status page in 10m.

oncall-sre: closing initial triage. continuing to monitor. please react with :thumbsup: when you have action items assigned.

santiago: :thumbsup: will follow up with full RCA and timeline on the postmortem doc.

emily: :thumbsup:

raj: taking over live mitigation and escalations. last_message_ts 6876543899 — will post updates in-thread.
